solutionSql:
SELECT c.id,
       c.name
FROM customers c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM shipments s
  WHERE s.customer_id = c.id
    AND s.status = 'delivered'
)
ORDER BY c.id;

ambiguities.phrase: Return id and name for customers with no shipment whose status is delivered.
ambiguities.readingChosen: Customers with no shipments at all qualify, since they have no delivered shipment.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Only customers with at least one shipment, none of them delivered, qualify. That reading returns no rows in this sample.

notes: Customers 7 and 8 have no shipments, so NOT EXISTS returns them. Customers 1 to 6 each have a delivered shipment, which is why the second reading is empty here.
